# Pipeline Requirements Checklist: Transcription Results Pipeline

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for upload eligibility, server-owned processing, result delivery, and privacy boundaries before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Gate Boundary Completeness

- [X] CHK001 Are diagnostic-only local quality signals exhaustively identified so implementation cannot reintroduce a hidden quality blocker? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Contract upload eligibility]
- [X] CHK002 Are hard blocking conditions separated from diagnostic-only warnings with no overlap or contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-002]
- [X] CHK003 Is the requirement to keep server integrity checks specific enough to cover roles, object count, byte length, checksum, and immutable fingerprint? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Plan Constraints]
- [X] CHK004 Are consent, permission, access, and deletion gates documented as separate from audio quality gates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002/FR-011]

## Processing Lifecycle Clarity

- [X] CHK005 Is automatic processing start scoped clearly to accepted uploads and enabled/available processing dependencies? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [X] CHK006 Are disabled, unavailable, retryable, blocked, and terminal dependency states defined without implying upload failure? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006/FR-008]
- [X] CHK007 Are idempotency requirements measurable for duplicate pickup, worker restart, external submission, and import retry scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005, SC-002]
- [X] CHK008 Is the accepted media revision identity clearly defined as the processing boundary for current and future result versions? [Traceability, Data Model Accepted Media Revision]

## Result Surface Coverage

- [X] CHK009 Are web and desktop review expectations defined for ready, partial, blocked, failed, and running states? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]
- [X] CHK010 Are transcript availability, diarization availability, speaker/provenance labels, and media revision identity all required in review surfaces? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [X] CHK011 Is the difference between status-only payloads and authorized transcript-content surfaces explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Contract processing result delivery]
- [X] CHK012 Are empty, partial, and failed result states required to avoid inventing transcript content? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 3]

## Offline And Retry Consistency

- [X] CHK013 Are delayed upload, reconnect, restart, and retry scenarios represented in requirements and edge cases? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [X] CHK014 Are duplicate meeting, duplicate media revision, duplicate job, and duplicate result prevention requirements documented together? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005/FR-009]
- [X] CHK015 Are lifecycle-blocked and deleted-meeting scenarios specified for pending or in-flight processing? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]

## Privacy And Evidence Quality

- [X] CHK016 Are forbidden content classes defined consistently across spec, plan, contracts, and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [X] CHK017 Are metadata-safe evidence allowances defined so validators know what can be recorded without leaking meeting content? [Clarity, Contracts evidence rules]
- [X] CHK018 Are external dependency failures required to expose safe reason codes instead of provider payloads or private content? [Security, Spec §User Story 4]
- [X] CHK019 Are desktop direct egress and provider credential boundaries stated clearly enough to prevent bypass implementation paths? [Security, Plan Constraints]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [X] CHK020 Are success criteria measurable for processing start latency, orchestration overhead, duplicate prevention, review parity, and content-safety evidence? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [X] CHK021 Are all P1 user stories independently testable without requiring AEC/noise suppression completion from feature 044? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK022 Are out-of-scope items documented clearly enough to prevent tasks for local two-speaker mic optimization, transcript editing, trimming, reprocess, or video review? [Scope, Plan Scale/Scope]
